senses.gloss:
रंसु रंसु, उस्, उस्, उ (said by some to be
fr. rt. रण्, but according to Nirukta VI. 17. and
Sāy. fr. rt. रम्), Ved. cheerful, joyful, delightful;
(उ), ind. cheerfully, delightfully, (Sāy. = रमणी-
येषु, i. e. आज्यादि-हविःषु, in oblations, &c.)
—रंसु-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a pleasing
tongue or voice, (Sāy. = रमणीय-ज्वालोपेत, pos-
sessing a pleasing tongue of flame.)

रंह् रंह् (connected with rt. लङ्घ्; cf.
rt. रङ्घ्), cl. 1. P. रंहति (also Ved. A.
रंहते), ररंह, रंहितुम्, to go, move with
speed, hasten; to make to run or go rapidly, cause
to flow; to flow: Caus. रंहयति (according to
some also रंहापयति), to cause to move rapidly,
urge on; to cause to flow; to go; to speak; to
shine, (in the last two senses a various reading for
rt. वंह्); [cf. perhaps Gr. τρέχ-ω; Goth. thrag-
ja.]
रंह = रंहस् below.
रंहण, अम्, n. going swiftly, hastening.

रंहति, इस्, f. (?), speed, velocity; the speed of
a chariot.

रंहमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, moving or flowing
rapidly, (Sāy. = वेगं कुर्वाण.)

रंहस्, अस्, n. speed, quickness, velocity; eager-
ness, vehemence, violence, impetuosity; N. of Śiva,
(Vehemence personified); of Viṣṇu.
रंहस at the end of an adj. comp. = रंहस्.

रंहि, इस्, f., Ved. the act of running or flowing,
a running stream; the making to run, pursuing,
hunting; speed, haste, flight.
रन्धक, अस्, इका, अम्, subduing, destroying.
रन्धक, रन्धन, &c. See above.

रन्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, one who destroys, a de-
stroyer; (अम्), n. the act of destroying or annihilat-
ing; the act of cooking, preparation or dressing of
food.

रन्धनाय, Nom. P. रन्धनायति, &c., Ved.
to make subject, deliver into the power of, (Sāy. =
वशी-कृ.)

रन्धस्, आस्, or रन्धस, अस्, m., N. of a man
belonging to the family of Andhaka.

रन्धि, इस्, f. subjection, subjugation (Ved.); the
being prepared or cooked; cooking.

रन्धित, अस्, आ, अम्, subdued; destroyed; cooked,
dressed (as food).

रन्धिष, अस्, m., Ved. = हन्तृ, a destroyer
(Vājasaneyi-s. VIII. 55).
रन् 1. रन् = rt. रण्, q. v.

रन् 2. रन् in Ṛg-veda I. 120, 7, according
to Sāy. = रातारौ = दातारौ, ‘givers,’ as if pres. part.
of rt. 1. रा, the sing. being substituted for the dual.

1. रन्ति, इस्, m., Ved. (according to some) a
fighter, warrior, (but according to Sāy. रन्ति = र-
ममाण, रमण-शील, delighting, taking pleasure,
as if fr. rt. रम्, see 2. रन्ति at p. 833, col. 3.)

2. रन्ति, इस्, f. (for 1. see p. 832, col. 2), amuse-
ment, pleasure, delight (? Ved., if रन्ति has this
sense, it may equally be referred to rt. 1. रन्; it is
said also to be used as a term of endearment for a
cow); (इस्), m., N. of a lexicographer (= रन्ति-देव).
—रन्ति-देव, अस्, m., N. of Viṣṇu; of a king
(son of Saṅkṛti); of a lexicographer; a dog.
—रन्ति-
नार or रन्ति-भार, अस्, m., N. of a king.

रन्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to some)
agreeable, pleasant, (perhaps to be connected with rt.
रम्, but in Ṛg-veda X. 29, 3. another reading has
रंह्य.)
रन्त्य रन्त्य. See above.
रन्तव्य रन्तव्य, रन्ति, रन्तृ. See p. 833.

रन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rejoiced at, to be
loved, lovable, lovely, amiable; (अम्), n. pleasure,
enjoyment, play.
रन्तु रन्तु, उस्, f. a way, road; a river.

रन्दला रन्दला, f., N. of Sañjñā (wife of
the Sun).
रन्ध् रन्ध् = rt. रध्, q. v.

रन्ध्र रन्ध्र, अम्, n. (rarely also अस्, m.;
said to be fr. rt. रध्, probably connected with rt.
रद्), a slit, split, opening, fissure, aperture, hole,
chasm, vent, cavity, (nine openings are usually
reckoned in the human body, viz. two in the nose,
eyes, and ears respectively, one in the mouth, urethra,
and anus, and there is an imaginary tenth opening
in the skull); a symbolical expression for the number
nine; N. of a particular part of a horse's head; a
defect, fault, flaw, imperfection, weak part, assailable
point; N. of the eighth astrological mansion.
—रन्-
[]
ध्र-कण्ट, अस्, m. a species of plant (= जाल-
वर्वूरक).
—रन्ध्र-प्रहारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, attack-
ing the weak places (of an enemy).
—रन्ध्र-
बभ्रु, उस्, m. a rat.
—रन्ध्र-वंश, अस्, m. a
hollow bamboo.
—रन्ध्रागत (˚र-आग्˚), अम्, n.
a disease which attacks the throat of horses.
—रन्-
ध्रानुसारिन् (˚र-अन्˚) or रन्ध्रान्वेषिन् (˚र-
अन्˚), ई, इणी, इ, looking out for flaws, picking holes,
seeking for weak or assailable points; [cf. छिद्रान्-
वेषिन्.]
—रन्ध्रान्वेषण (˚र-अन्˚), अम्, n.
the act of seeking for weak places, picking holes,
searching for flaws.
—रन्ध्रापेक्षिन् (˚र-अप्˚), ई,
इणी, इ, watching for weak or assailable places, spying
out holes, looking out for an assailable point.

रन्तु-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (रन्तु for रन्तुम्,
inf. of rt. रम्), inclined to take pleasure, wishing
to enjoy sexual pleasures.

रन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. liking to remain, de-
lighting in.
रान्द्र्य रान्द्र्य, various reading for राण्ड्य.
रान्धस रान्धस, अस्, m. a patronymic.
